description: What the keyless ROZO Funding API supports right now: whether stellar_onboarding is on, the source chains and USDC assets, the Stellar USDC output, the usdGas options (XLM amounts) and per-order limits. Read-only, creates nothing. Fees come from the quote (fees and totals): never assume a fee. The receiving Stellar address signs ONE transaction (only when it is new or has no USDC trustline). The one-time deposit address is the same on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Polygon; USDC or USDT is accepted 1:1. Follow deposit.amountPolicy: exact or missing means pay the EXACT deposit amount; any_amount uses the suggested amount and returned min/max bounds. Pay once, before payBefore. This server never holds keys: your own wallet pays and signs.
name: funding_capabilities
title: Stellar wallet funding capabilities
